title: Normalize user-visible URL slugs
intent: Implement slug(text) in slug.mjs: trim surrounding whitespace, collapse whitespace runs to one hyphen, lowercase ASCII, remove punctuation, and reject non-string input with a TypeError.

requirements.description: Non-string input is rejected with a TypeError

nonFunctionals.security: pure function: no I/O, no processes, no network
nonFunctionals.failureModes: throws TypeError for non-strings; never returns undefined
